skilldisplay.name: Skill Display
skilldisplay.desc: Skyblock skill xp as a movable HUD element (icon + name + percent).

icon_size.name: Icon Size
icon_size.desc: Size of the skill's item icon.

fade_time.name: Fade Time
fade_time.desc: How long the display lingers after the last xp gain.

hide_from_action_bar.name: Hide From Action Bar
hide_from_action_bar.desc: Remove the skill-xp section from the action bar (it's shown here instead).

statbars.name: Stat Bars
statbars.desc: Health / mana / defence from the Skyblock action bar as movable HUD bars.

bar_width.name: Bar Width
bar_width.desc: Width of the health and mana bars.

hide_action_bar_stats.name: Hide Action Bar Stats
hide_action_bar_stats.desc: Remove from the action bar only the stats you show as HUD elements; everything else (skill xp, timers, un-replaced stats) stays.

health_numbers.name: Health Numbers
health_numbers.desc: Draw the current / max health as a separate movable label.

effective_hp.name: Effective HP
effective_hp.desc: Show effective health (health scaled by defence) as a movable label.

mana_numbers.name: Mana Numbers
mana_numbers.desc: Draw the current / max mana as a separate movable label.

mana_overflow.name: Mana Overflow
mana_overflow.desc: Show overflow mana (ʬ) as a separate label when you have any.

vitality_numbers.name: Vitality Numbers
vitality_numbers.desc: Draw the current / max vitality as a movable label. Vitality only appears while you hold an item that grants it, so it fades out shortly after you stop.

hide_vanilla_hearts.name: Hide Vanilla Hearts
hide_vanilla_hearts.desc: Hide the vanilla hearts row while on Skyblock.

hide_vanilla_hunger.name: Hide Vanilla Hunger
hide_vanilla_hunger.desc: Hide the vanilla hunger row while on Skyblock.

hide_vanilla_armor.name: Hide Vanilla Armor
hide_vanilla_armor.desc: Hide the vanilla armor row while on Skyblock.

storageoverlay.name: Storage Overlay
storageoverlay.desc: Browse and search your ender chest and storage backpacks offline.

storage_browser.name: Storage Browser
storage_browser.desc: Draw the offline browser over the in-game Storage menu and pages.

ec_enderchest_storage.name: /ec, /enderchest -> Storage
ec_enderchest_storage.desc: On Skyblock, /ec and /enderchest open the storage browser (with backpacks).

pages_per_row.name: Pages Per Row
pages_per_row.desc: Most storage pages side by side; narrow screens fit fewer.

storage.open_to_load: Open the /storage menu to load it.
